About Our Business

Welcome to Sri Paranjyothi Handicrafts

At Sri Paranjyothi Handicrafts, we bring together the natural beauty of gemstones and the charm of traditional craftsmanship.

Our collections include beautiful natural gemstone bracelets, semi-precious stone beads, Moissanite diamonds and handcrafted gift items.

We believe every gemstone has its own unique beauty and every handcrafted piece can become a meaningful treasure.

Discover our collections and connect with us to find something special.
